name: Environmental Defense Fund
story: $1,000 funds work for climate rules, cleaner air and safer water, and every **{climate: 1 / tco2e_per_donor_dollar|$}** keeps a tonne of greenhouse gas out of the air.
summary: Science, economics, law and advocacy for environmental policy: methane and other climate rules in the US, Europe and beyond, the MethaneSAT satellite, clean air and lead pipes, toxic chemicals, fisheries and farms.
